The .009 assembly view PXL_20260711_114611058.jpg places R59 to the right of D56, below R47, whereas this fitted 33К body lies to the left between D103 and D56. One different upright red body is fitted to D56's right across the two nearby source R47/R59 callout levels; its marking is unresolved and position alone does not select either reference. Thus value supports the left-body R59 hypothesis but assembly side contradicts a direct positional match; a relocated part or different reference is possible, and neither endpoint is net-proved.
